title: Parts and assemblies
summary: How a model is split into parts: how many parts, the smallest detail, how parts are grouped, pivot points and how many segments round parts get.

request.brief: Submit a finished, multi-part asset as you deliver it: every part a separate object, organised into your usual collections or hierarchy, with any pivot or socket empties you add.
must_include: A finished asset with its parts kept separate
Your collections or parenting for assemblies
Pivot or socket empties if you use them

questions.ask: How do you decide what becomes its own part or assembly?
